title: Hooded Procession of Skeletons
description: A line of five black skeletons with yellow eyes stands in the foreground, each dripping thick red liquid from their skulls and ribcages. Behind them, a dark surreal background is filled with concentric psychedelic spirals in vibrant green, purple, and yellow, containing floating female faces and dripping colorful orbs.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a row of five black hooded skeletons with glowing yellow eyes, red liquid dripping heavily from their skulls and bones. They stand in profile facing left against a dark background filled with concentric circles and hypnotic spirals in vibrant purple, lime green, and yellow. Floating stylized female faces appear within the spirals, with colorful dripping orbs and paint splatters throughout the composition in a dark vibrant macabre style.
